title: Harden port-forward reconcile and coalescing
description: Complete bounded reconciliation for automatic port forwarding, including grace periods, concurrent requests, stale rules, and truthful forwarding state.
acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent reconciles for the same rule coalesce and all callers resolve within the configured bound
Idle and grace-period behavior is deterministic and covered by tests
A removed/disabled rule releases its listener and process resources
Forwarding state reflects the actual listener/remote probe rather than only the desired configuration
A failed reconcile emits a sanitized diagnostic and does not retry in a tight loop

steps.description: Cover idle return, grace period, concurrent calls, rule removal, listener failure, and repeated failure with fake timers.

steps.details: Read `apps/web/src/lib/forward-supervisor.ts`, forwarder, and related API/action routes; record in-flight keys, timer ownership, and cleanup.
Preserve existing coalescing/grace semantics and add only missing state/cleanup/error handling supported by failing tests.

steps.description: Run focused reconcile tests, custom harness, typecheck, and lint.

technicalNotes: Port-forward tests already exist in `scripts/test-optimizations.ts`; extend them rather than creating a competing harness for the same behavior.
